tool.name: pixy
tool.description: Unbiased estimates of pi, dxy, fst, Watterson's theta, and Tajima's D from VCFs with invariant sites
tool.command: ln -s '$vcf' input.vcf.gz && if [ -f '${vcf.metadata.tabix_index}' ]; then ln -s '${vcf.metadata.tabix_index}' input.vcf.gz.tbi; fi && pixy --stats `echo '$stats' | tr ',' ' '` --vcf input.vcf.gz --populations '$populations' #if str($windowing.windowing_type) == 'window_size': --window_size $windowing.window_size #else: --bed_file '$windowing.bed_file' #end if --output_folder pixy_output --output_prefix pixy #if $chromosomes: --chromosomes '$chromosomes' #end if #if $interval_start: --interval_start $interval_start #end if #if $interval_end: --interval_end $interval_end #end if --n_cores \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} #if $sites_file: --sites_file '$sites_file' #end if #if $chunk_size: --chunk_size $chunk_size #end if #if 'fst' in str($stats): --fst_type $fst_options.fst_type #if $fst_options.fst_components: --fst_components #end if #if $fst_options.fst_biallelic: --fst_biallelic #end if #end if #if 'tajima_d' in str($stats) and $advanced.tajima_components: --tajima_components #end if #if $advanced.include_multiallelic_snps: --include_multiallelic_snps #end if #if $advanced.bypass_invariant_check: --bypass_invariant_check #end if #if str($callable_sites.wisp_bed) != 'None' and $callable_sites.wisp_bed: --wisp_bed '$callable_sites.wisp_bed' #end if #if $advanced.gvcf: --gvcf #if $advanced.gvcf_max_block_size: --gvcf_max_block_size $advanced.gvcf_max_block_size #end if #end if && cd pixy_output && for stat in pi dxy fst watterson_theta tajima_d; do if [ -f "pixy_\${stat}.txt" ]; then case "\${stat}" in pi) cp "pixy_\${stat}.txt" '$pi_output';; dxy) cp "pixy_\${stat}.txt" '$dxy_output';; fst) cp "pixy_\${stat}.txt" '$fst_output';; watterson_theta) cp "pixy_\${stat}.txt" '$watterson_output';; tajima_d) cp "pixy_\${stat}.txt" '$tajima_output';; esac; fi; done

param.name: stats
param.label: Statistics to calculate
param.help: Select one or more population genetics statistics

param.name: vcf
param.label: Input VCF
param.help: Bgzipped and tabix-indexed VCF with invariant sites. Required for unbiased estimates.

param.name: populations
param.label: Populations file
param.help: Headerless tab-separated file with columns: SampleID, Population

param.name: window_size
param.label: Window size (bp)
param.help: Window size in base pairs for calculating statistics

param.name: bed_file
param.label: BED file
param.help: Headerless BED file with columns: chrom, chromStart, chromEnd

param.name: chromosomes
param.label: Chromosomes
param.help: Comma-separated list of chromosomes (e.g. '1,2,X'). Defaults to all chromosomes in the VCF.

param.name: interval_start
param.label: Interval start
param.help: Only valid for a single chromosome. Defaults to 1.

param.name: interval_end
param.label: Interval end
param.help: Only valid for a single chromosome. Defaults to the last position.

param.name: sites_file
param.label: Sites file
param.help: Headerless tab-separated file with columns: CHROM, POS. Restricts calculation to specific sites.

param.name: chunk_size
param.label: Chunk size
param.help: Approximate number of sites to read from VCF at a time (default: 100000). Larger values reduce I/O at the cost of memory.

param.name: fst_components
param.label: Include FST components
param.help: Output the numerator and denominator components of the FST estimator

param.name: fst_biallelic
param.label: Restrict FST to biallelic sites
param.help: Only affects Hudson FST with --include_multiallelic_snps. WC FST is always biallelic. Excluded sites still contribute to pi and dxy.

param.name: wisp_bed
param.label: Wisp-format callable-sites BED
param.help: Must be bgzipped and tabix-indexed. VCF is treated as variants-only with denominators from this mask. Incompatible with --gvcf. See https://github.com/samuk-lab/wisp

param.name: tajima_components
param.label: Include Tajima's D components
param.help: Output aggregation components for summing Tajima's D across windows

param.name: include_multiallelic_snps
param.label: Include multiallelic SNPs
param.help: Include multiallelic SNPs in calculations (default: excluded)

param.name: bypass_invariant_check
param.label: Bypass invariant site check
param.help: Allow computation without invariant sites. Use with extreme caution — will produce biased estimates. Prefer --wisp_bed for variants-only VCFs.

param.name: gvcf
param.label: Input is GVCF
param.help: Treat input VCF as a joint-called GVCF (GATK format with ALT=<NON_REF> blocks). Incompatible with wisp BED.

tool.help:
**pixy**: Unbiased estimates of pi, dxy, fst, Watterson's theta, and Tajima's D from VCFs with invariant sites.
When invariant sites are excluded from a VCF, estimates of pi, dxy, and fst become biased because the denominator (total callable sites) is unknown. pixy requires all-sites VCFs to produce unbiased estimates.
**Requirements:** - Input VCF must be bgzipped and tabix-indexed - VCF must contain invariant sites (unless using a wisp BED or --bypass_invariant_check) - Populations file: headerless tab-separated, columns [SampleID, Population]
**Variants-only VCFs:** - Use a wisp-format callable-sites BED to provide per-window denominators - Or use --bypass_invariant_check (will produce biased estimates) - Or use --gvcf for GATK GVCF inputs (incompatible with wisp BED)
**Statistics:** - **pi**: Nucleotide diversity within populations - **dxy**: Divergence between populations - **fst**: Fixation index (Weir & Cockerham or Hudson estimator) - **Watterson's theta**: Population mutation rate - **Tajima's D**: Neutrality test
